environment: iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.5, Expo Go development build
scenario: Synthetic level 29; alternate Lotus Wheel and Heavenly Swords every 12 simulated seconds, charge for 650 ms, attempt a cast every 1700 ms.
caveat: Sequential diagnostic windows, not a controlled physical-device benchmark. Before and after world states were not identical. Does not establish zero stutter or battery/thermal behavior.
